basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and fantasy fiction enthusiast, hailing from the Pacific Northwest. By day, I work as a software developer, but by night, I'm delving into the intricate lore of games like Hollow Knight and building mods. I'm particularly fascinated by the intersection of storytelling and interactive media, which inspires my own writing and fan fiction projects. When not online, I enjoy hiking the lush trails of my region. I'm currently single and often online during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Having a background in computer science with a degree from a state university, I have spent years honing my programming skills both through formal education and personal projects. My expertise extends to game development, particularly in scripting for indie games. I also have a decent grasp of parental control technologies, as I volunteer to educate parents on digital safety.
